audit.why: 60.53% over 38 games. Aurora out-ranges the single level-1 shot with Twofold Hex (900 vs Avengerang 850), then Akshan owns 2 through first item on the double-shot passive, and Aurora reclaims late once she can hop every commit. Even/5.5 difficulty matches.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase whys were generic and named no Aurora ability or timing.
audit.why: The real spikes are her level 2 W (Across the Veil, 22/21/20/19/18) and her full AP build; Akshan's are level 3 Heroic Swing, level 6 Comeuppance (missing-health scaling) and the Youmuu's window where a takedown drops Heroic Swing to a 0.5s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The FULL layer named no Aurora ability except a padded 'Across the Veil (Hop)' label, and the content layer twice asserts a 'Q root' that Aurora does not have.
audit.why: Riot's Twofold Hex text is a missile that curses enemies plus a recast that drags the curses back for damage — no root anywhere. Aurora's disengage is The Weirding (E, 15/14/13/12/11), which slows and hops her backward, and Across the Veil (W, 22/21/20/19/18), a leap into invisibility. Those two, not a root, are what break Akshan's Comeuppance lock and his Heroic Swing chase. Heroic Swing also needs terrain to anchor.
audit.corrected: Named Twofold Hex, Across the Veil, The Weirding and Between Worlds; replaced the phantom 'Q root' with the Twofold Hex recast; keyed every commit to the W/E downtime.
